setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: A new project with playback stopped, the default C major scale and Rate /1 (one step is a sixteenth note) on every channel. Channel 1 is set up and its Device page is open: it plays range 1-4, MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, to its own MIDI output. Channel 2 is not set up yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap channel 2 at (2,1), turn E1 to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Device and press K3. The header reads CH02: this second channel will play a three-step loop.
steps.title: Select channel 2

steps.caption: Give channel 2 its own MIDI output on the Device page. Give it pattern 1 and the range steps 1-3 (hold step 1 and tap step 3), then open Masks and set its values: Note 79, Vel 40 and Len ½ on every step, with step 2 locked to Note 81, Vel 60 and Len 1¼. Select channel 1 and press Play. Both channels start together on step 1. At step 4 channel 1 plays its fourth note, 65, while channel 2, whose three-step loop has wrapped, plays 79 again: look for 65 beside 79 in the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step".
steps.title: Build channel 2, then play both loops

steps.caption: Keep playing. Channel 1 loops four steps on its own MIDI port and channel 2 loops three on another, so their notes fall out of step and the MIDI strip shows two different phrases running side by side.
steps.title: Both channels keep looping

steps.caption: Keep playing. Hold step 4 and tap step 2 on channel 1: the reversed range (start 4, end 2) is refused and both loops carry on. Twelve steps after the start, the first step count that both 4 and 3 divide into, both phrases begin again from their first notes at the same moment: channel 1 plays 60 as channel 2 plays 79, and the next step plays 62 with 81. Look for that sequence in the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step", two seconds after the loops started.
steps.title: Both loops restart together at step 13

steps.caption: Press Stop. The refused reversed range changed nothing: both phrases keep the same timing, notes, velocities and lengths. Channel 1 still plays 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97 over steps 1 to 4, and channel 2 plays 79, 81, 79 over steps 1 to 3. Playback is stopped and the Masks screen is showing.
steps.title: Both loops stay locked
